{{Quote|R2, look out! Behind you! You're being followed by battle droids!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] upon seeing the [[Squad/Legends|squad]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
A '''squadron''' of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The units had been captured by the Republic and reprogrammed to serve it, participating in a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]] to free [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. During the ensuing battle, all units were destroyed when they were ordered to cover the retreat of the rest of the team.

==History==
[[File:ArtooBDSquadLastStand-CR.png|thumb|left|200px|The squad prepares to make their last stand against overwhelming enemy forces.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011" /> at least three [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] were captured and reprogrammed for use by the Galactic Republic, which put the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]<ref name="r2-db">{{DB|droid|r2d2|R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)}}</ref> [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in charge of the small squadron. The squad's only known mission was the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] of<ref name="TC" /> [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member<ref name="piell-db">{{DB|character|evenpiell|Piell, Even}}</ref> [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], during which the droids piloted a shuttle carrying the rescue team to the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] prison facility. They landed somewhere in the out-lands and deployed the team and later, they were ordered to pilot the shuttle to the Citadel's landing platform. There, the team was forced to abandon the shuttle to avoid suspicion from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces.<ref name="TC" />

While in the Citadel, the squad saved [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his team by pretending to be Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and escorted the "captured" team to the landing bay. It was during that time that the Separatists found out that the droids were reprogrammed and were serving the Republic, forcing the group to engage a group of Separatist droids sent after them. In the ensuing firefight, one of the squad's members was shot but not destroyed. After the apparent demise of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], the rescue team was forced to retreat and hide in a cave below the Citadel.<ref name="CA">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref> After contacting the Jedi Council for reinforcements, R2-D2's squad, along with the rescue team, went on to find a way to get to the extraction point, during which the unit was ordered to hold off the pursuing Confederate forces, which resulted in its destruction.<ref name="CR" /> The commander's final words to R2 were "It was an honor to serve with you sir."

==Behind the scenes==
In the episodes [[The Citadel (episode)|''The Citadel'']] and ''[[Counterattack]]'', there were three droids under R2's command among which one was later destroyed.<ref name="TC" /><ref name="CA" /> But in ''[[Citadel Rescue]]'', there are still three battle droids accompanying the team despite the one being destroyed in the previous episode.<ref name="CR" /> However, it is possible that the droid was not destroyed when it was shot.
